description: South Korea import duty and VAT: customs value = (price + freight + insurance) × customs FX rate (관세법 제30조), duty = value × rate, VAT = (value + duty) × 10%. Compares the general rate with an FTA preferential rate (only with proof of origin, FTA관세특례법 제8조) and checks the personal direct-purchase exemption (goods price ≤ USD 150, USD 200 from the US). Rates come from the user (HS code lookup at the customs law portal); no tariff classification. Excludes individual consumption/liquor taxes.

baseRate.description: General/WTO duty rate as a fraction, e.g. 0.13

ftaRate.description: FTA preferential rate as a fraction (omit or equal to baseRate if none)

fx.description: Customs FX rate, KRW per USD
